statements.status_notes: CRLF injection in io.netty.handler.proxy.HttpProxyHandler.newInitialMessage; the handler builds outbound HTTP CONNECT requests with header validation disabled. The netty-handler-proxy jar is embedded only inside the Cassandra Java driver shaded uber-jars (cql-*.jar, persistence-cassandra-4.0-*.jar). Stargate connects to Cassandra cluster nodes over CQL directly and never configures HttpProxyHandler, Socks4ProxyHandler, or Socks5ProxyHandler on any netty channel pipeline. HttpProxyHandler is never instantiated. Upstream fix in 4.1.133.Final is pinned via mvn-properties netty.version, but the cassandra-driver shaded jars carry their own pre-shaded 4.1.132.Final copies that the property override cannot rewrite.
